nova-flight.title: Tips
nova-flight.mob.tank: Enemy ships with reactive armor gradually reduce incoming damage
nova-flight.mob.speedster: Fast-moving targets are harder to hit — take them out first
nova-flight.mob.bomber: The Perdition Beam deals bonus damage to burning targets
nova-flight.mob.fighter: Missile fighters excel at hard-tracking missiles — keep moving while you attack
nova-flight.weapon.laser: Lasers have long range but low burst damage — great for harassment, or moral support
nova-flight.weapon.missile: Missiles track strongly but are easily shot down by point defense and fooled by decoys
nova-flight.weapon.plasma: Plasma weapons deal more damage the longer they charge
nova-flight.weapon.missile_guided: Missiles home in automatically — upgrade them to make them deadlier
nova-flight.weapon.cold: Cooling tech greatly reduces laser cooldown time
nova-flight.weapon.plasma_cannon: Kinetic artillery uses strong-interaction materials, punching through multiple ships in one shot
nova-flight.weapon.cannon: 90mm and 125mm cannons pack devastating explosive power
nova-flight.weapon.explosion: Torpedoes have the largest blast radius among terrain-destroying explosions
nova-flight.weapon.ciws: The CIWS is a real frame-killer
nova-flight.defense.shield: The EMP shield blocks damage, but needs time to recharge
nova-flight.defense.armor: Armor gives permanent protection, but erosion weapons can corrode it
nova-flight.strategy.flank: Try flanking instead of head-on fights — most people only shoot straight ahead!
nova-flight.strategy.focus: Focus fire on the BOSS before it causes too much trouble
nova-flight.strategy.retreat: When health gets low, pause and take a deep breath — regroup, or go out gloriously
nova-flight.strategy.escape: When missiles lock on, stay calm: pop decoys (press X) or shoot them down with CIWS
nova-flight.upgrade.damage: Upgrading weapons boosts the damage of all equipment — press G to open the R&D page
nova-flight.upgrade.speed: No one can resist the traverse gear
nova-flight.upgrade.hull: Reinforcing the hull increases your max health
nova-flight.upgrade.cold: Fun fact: I know you're playing on a computer right now
nova-flight.upgrade.emp: EMP clears enemy fire within a radius
nova-flight.upgrade.radombomb: Random shells often fire something unexpected — a powerful upgrade, though pricey
nova-flight.upgrade.radargun: Flak guns auto-attack enemies and intercept missiles — upgrade them for better support
nova-flight.lore.shadow_race: The Shadow Clan's lossless dimensional-shift tech lets them harass Imperial borders under Elder "Dweller"
nova-flight.lore.emp_tech: The invention of electromagnetic oscillation changed the war — it can paralyze enemy warships
nova-flight.lore.logic_war: Rumor has it the Polar Defense Front was born when its leader spotted a polar bear
nova-flight.lore.polaris_birth: Facing Imperial decay and the bug threat, the Polaris resistance rose
nova-flight.lore.northern_alliance: The Northern Alliance supplies the Polar Defense Front with arms and tech
nova-flight.easteregg.ancient_tech: Some fighter wrecks still show traces of Shadow Clan dimensional-shift tech...
nova-flight.easteregg.nest_heart: Legend says the Shadow Clan hive mother's core still beats somewhere, fueling Imperial fleet jumps
nova-flight.easteregg.polaris_symbol: The five stars of the Polaris emblem stand for hope, courage, wisdom, unity, and freedom
nova-flight.easteregg.colossus_shadow: Some claim to have seen a colossal shadow in deep space — an undestroyed Colossus?
nova-flight.easteregg.truso_trade: Truso Federation merchants still sail certain routes, but they stay neutral
nova-flight.easteregg.horus_legacy: Vice Admiral Horus's rebel remnants are said to still linger in some star system
nova-flight.easteregg.quantum_spear: The Luminari quantum spear tech is lost, though its principles are still studied — now each loss is permanent
nova-flight.easteregg.fourth_emperor: The Star Destroyer boasts immense firepower, but it's so unwieldy it needs tugboats to turn around in port
nova-flight.easteregg.dimension_gate: Shadow Clan dimensional gates — humanity still can't fully understand them, only that they work
nova-flight.easteregg.location: Despite the cold name, the Polar Defense Front HQ sits on a temperate oceanic planet
nova-flight.technicality.blocks: Map blocks are a bit smaller than they look
nova-flight.technicality.bullet: Do you know which version made bullet hitboxes smaller?
